objective: Bind the SPA session view's panes (request, activity, artifacts, proof band) to the daemon's session record, its receipts and its workspace events; keep the served /__ioi/sessions readout as the Operations inspection lane; make the operator's parked approval reachable from the session the run was submitted in.
falsifiable_claim: The run-timeline projection the SPA session pane renders names the daemon session's ref and lifecycle state read under the caller's identity, carries exactly the record's latest_receipt_refs and the receipts they name (kind, lease, scopes), feeds artifacts from the daemon's workspace diff when the cache has none, renders a parked run as an awaiting-approval card with the exact commitments, the daemon's grant audience and the approve/deny endpoints, and renders a decided run with no endpoint; a run that fails closed without an authority node shows exactly that with no fabricated receipt.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: check:session-truth-rebind (11/11 on 2026-09-07) drives the pure projection with a parked, a decided and a bound run, then an isolated daemon + serve where a real composer run fails closed and the pane's session ref, lifecycle state and receipt refs are compared field-by-field with the daemon record; the live awaiting card and post-execution receipt binding are asserted by check:alpha-journey (deployment mode).
remaining_nonclaims: The SPA's own React panes are not rewritten; the bound projection is the owned Run Timeline frame the /details lane mounts (canonical-app doctrine: bundle + adapter lane, no parallel runtime).
Per-session cost is not projected (profile step 7 stays partial on cost).
No landing-designation JSON row was added; the designation is recorded in core-clients-surfaces.md § Session surface.
